department: Environmental Science Ph.D. Program, College of Science, Engineering and Technology

deadline.value: Fall admission deadline for the Ph.D. in Environmental Science is March 1, 2027 (matching the March 1 Graduate Assistantship and Tuition-waiver deadline); students may also begin in Spring or Summer.
deadline.quote: Fall Admission: March 1 | Ph.D. in Environmental Science

also.quote: Environmental Science students may begin enrollment at the beginning of each semester and the summer term.

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores are required for admission to the Ph.D. in Environmental Science.
gre_general.quote: An official score on the Graduate Record Examination (GRE).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Environmental Science; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by the Environmental Science Doctoral Advisory Committee; upon admission, the Program Director serves as temporary advisor until a major professor is selected.
supervisor.quote: Immediately upon being accepted into the program, the Program Director will assume the role of temporary advisor for the student until a major professor is selected.

also.quote: All applications received are reviewed by a standing Environmental Science Doctoral Advisory Committee that recommends acceptance or denial of admission to the Graduate School.

funding.value: Division of Graduate Studies Graduate Assistantships (monthly stipend plus tuition for Fall and Spring) and partial/full Graduate Tuition-waivers are awarded competitively via separate application to the department chair or academic dean by March 1.
funding.quote: The Division of Graduate Studies awards assistantships each year with a monthly stipend plus tuition for one academic year: Fall and Spring... The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

entry_route.value: Admission is open to holders of a master's degree in natural or related sciences (3.25+ GPA on the program page, 3.00 in the catalog); bachelor's-only applicants are considered only with exceptional potential (3.5+ GPA [3.35 in catalog], satisfactory GRE, and exceptional work experience).
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree in natural sciences or related sciences from an accredited university. An applicant with a Bachelor’s degree only may be admitted when that student shows exceptional potential as determined by a GPA of 3.5 or better, a satisfactory GRE, and exceptional work experience.

notes: Program requires an on-site/supervised writing sample and an interview with the program Steering Committee.
